title: Allowing larger private rain catchment tanks
summary: Bill 180 would allow private rain catchment tanks of up to 30,000 gallons in agricultural, residential and rural districts. Earlier, in October 2024, the private water catchment bill, listed as Bill 153, was sent to the Water and Infrastructure Committee. A water tank contractor said rainfall at his home fell from 160 to 80 inches a year.
